title: Curvature distributions and the Steiner formula for characteristic surfaces in the Heisenberg group
summary: We establish a new Steiner-type formula for smooth surfaces in the sub-Riemannian Heisenberg group. The main novelty is that we admit characteristic points, whose presence produces nontrivial singularities both of the distance from the surface and of its tubular neighborhood.
